case.title: Exactly two contributors on one device, and the second one only appears after the target

submissions.open_text: The tap in our compound runs only in the mornings so we store water in jerry cans.
Queue at the communal kiosk takes almost an hour on weekends.
Handcart sellers raised prices after the rains damaged the road.

case.why: dev-k1 has submissions from exactly 2 distinct contributors: E01 (a, c) and P01 (b). That meets the 'at least 2' threshold, so a must fire. Two edges are probed. First, the target's own contributor counts toward the 2; an implementation that requires 2 contributors other than the target's own would stay silent. Second, P01's submission comes 16 days after a; an implementation that only looks at earlier submissions on the device, or that evaluates once at sync time and never re-evaluates, would miss it. The other checks stay quiet: E01's two submissions are on different days, durations are above the minimums, all points are inside Kondele, times are daytime and voice transcripts are empty.
